title: Parliamentary Speech Finder (UK + DE): multilingual semantic search over Hansard and GermaParl
description: A retrieval-only research prototype for multilingual semantic search over parliamentary speeches from the UK House of Commons (Hansard) and the German Bundestag (GermaParl). Speeches are embedded with jina-embeddings-v4 (multilingual, 2048-d, 32k context) into a shared cross-lingual space; queries are encoded with the Jina v4 retrieval adapter and matched via FAISS IVF-PQ with year filtering. It returns similarity-ranked speeches with no model-generated summary. Code only; no corpora or embeddings are included or distributed.
